title: Who are the account holder identification numbers whose who have transactio
question:
Who are the account holder identification numbers whose who have transactions on the credit card with the amount is less than the average, in 1998?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' refers to credit card withdrawal

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT d.XCL_014
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.XCL_047 = a.XCL_001
JOIN disp d ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
JOIN card c ON d.XCL_013 = c.XCL_006
WHERE t.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_048) = '1998'
  AND t.XCL_051 < (SELECT AVG(XCL_051) FROM trans WHERE XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND strftime('%Y', XCL_048) = '1998')
